summary_en: 360,000 shares (1.2% of S/O) up to ¥1.0B via open-market purchase on TSE Prime, Aug 14–Sep 30, 2026. Rationale: flexible capital allocation in response to business environment changes.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: PKSHA Technology Inc. announced on 31 July 2026 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 360,000 shares of its own common stock on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market, from 14 August to 30 September 2026, within a total budget cap of ¥1.0 billion. The 360,000 shares represent approximately 1.2% of shares outstanding (computed as 360,000 ÷ 30,896,513 ex-treasury shares). The company states the acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase to support flexible capital allocation responsive to changes in the business environment. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 1,051,487 treasury shares against 30,896,513 shares outstanding excluding treasury.
